Integrated batch processing

Three systems work as one controlled cycle

The supplied system description combines chemical spray cleaning, DI-water rinsing and hot-air drying in one automatic process. Engineers can retain access to the main process variables during setup.

01

Integrated clean, rinse and dry

One automatic sequence runs chemical spray cleaning, DI-water rinsing and controlled hot-air drying.

02

Three-level rotating spray

Upper, middle and lower rotating spray bars support access around the two-level loading fixture.

03

Adjustable process control

Time, temperature, rinse cycles, spray pressure and drying conditions can be adjusted for the assembly.

Internal fluid management

Fluid control supports repeatable batch processing

Heated tanks, recirculation and monitoring

  • Heated process tanks30 L concentrate, 60 L dilution and 18 L spray-tank capacities.
  • Chemical recirculationCleaning liquid returns through a filtration loop for controlled batch processing.
  • Pressure indicationReal-time pressure gauges support monitoring of key fluid circuits.
  • Rinsing-water monitoringResistivity monitoring range: 0–18 MΩ.

Sample evaluation

Sample testing defines the final recipe

The process should be released only after representative boards pass the agreed checks. Use sample trials to confirm chemistry, materials compatibility, residue removal, drying and electrical function.

FAQ

Questions before process evaluation

The key question is not simply whether a board can enter the chamber. The released process must also protect the specific components, materials and inspection requirement.

Start an engineering review
What should we provide for an evaluation?

Provide representative uncleaned PCBAs, board size, component height, expected batch quantity, flux or solder-paste information, cleaning-agent information, sensitive components and the target inspection method.

Can the machine handle double-sided boards?

The supplied material lists double-sided boards as an evaluation candidate, subject to fixture arrangement and process validation with representative assemblies.

Which settings are adjustable?

The supplied HMI slide lists adjustable cleaning and drying time, cleaning-liquid and rinse-water temperature, rinse cycles, drying temperature, time per rinse and spray pressure.

Are cleaning results guaranteed by the sample images?

No. The presentation labels its before-and-after example as illustrative. Actual results depend on the assembly, contamination, cleaning chemistry and validated settings.

What utilities need confirmation?

The supplied table lists AC 380 V / 50 Hz / 65 A and compressed air at 0.45–0.7 MPa. Confirm local utility standards, connection details and the general arrangement during engineering review.

Start with your actual assembly

Share the board data. We can evaluate the cleaning route.

Use the supplied machine information as a starting point, then confirm the fixture, chemistry, process recipe and final configuration against representative PCB assemblies.
